auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Sign in with the Super Admin account to manage your agent team.

errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait five minutes and try again.
errors.network: Cannot reach the server. Make sure the services are running.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: A live view of agents, tasks and costs.

resources.realOnly: Real provider calls only; Mock Provider excluded.

usageChart.title: Token usage — last 14 days
usageChart.empty: No usage recorded yet. It will appear here once a real AI provider is connected and tasks run.

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Create and manage AI agents without touching code.
agents.empty: No agents yet. Create one or start from a template.

confirm.archiveBody: The agent stops and is hidden from the list. You can restore it later.
confirm.deleteBody: This cannot be undone. A copy of its configuration stays in the audit log.

errors.agent_busy_stop_first: The agent is busy; stop it first.
errors.agent_disabled: The agent is disabled; enable it first.
errors.archive_first: Archive the agent before deleting it.
errors.tools: Some tools are not allowed for the selected security profile: {tools}

form.name: Name
form.identifierHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Generated if left empty.
form.toolsHelp: Tools above the security profile's ceiling are disabled. Merges and deployments only happen through human approval.

cli.help: The tool runs non-interactively in the sandbox with the API key and model of the provider selected above. Subscriptions (Claude Pro, ChatGPT Plus…) cannot be used.
cli.keyEnvHelp: The variable OpenCode reads for this provider's key, e.g. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.
cli.keyFrom: Uses the API key of the selected provider (must be {kinds}).
cli.keyFromAny: Uses the API key of the selected provider.
cli.kindMismatch: {tool} needs a {kinds} provider; choose a matching provider above.
cli.allowProjectConfig: Allow the repository's own configuration for this tool
cli.allowProjectConfigHelp: Off by default: if the workspace contains {files}, the run is refused, because such files can loosen the tool's approvals while the API key is available. Enable only for repositories you control.

templates.title: Agent templates
templates.subtitle: Customizable starting points to build your team fast.

providers.title: Providers & models
providers.subtitle: Connect AI providers through their official APIs and manage models and prices.
providers.subscriptionNote: A Claude.ai or ChatGPT subscription does not include API access; you need an API key from the provider's developer console.

fields.name: Name
fields.apiKeyHelp: Encrypted on save and never shown again.

providers.deleteBody: The provider, its key and models are deleted. Agents using it lose this provider.

models.title: Models
models.name: Model
models.priceHelp: Prices are never guessed: enter them from the provider's pricing page. Without a price no cost is calculated.
models.empty: No models. Discover them or add one manually.

errors.api_key_required: This provider needs an API key.
errors.base_url_required: This type needs a base URL.
errors.mock_provider_is_builtin: The mock provider is built in and cannot be deleted.

tasks.title: Task center
tasks.subtitle: Objectives, planned tasks, their agents, evidence and reviews.
tasks.projectHelp: A project groups objectives and limits which agents may work on them.
tasks.teamHelp: Only these agents can plan and execute this project's tasks. Leave empty to allow every agent.
tasks.objectiveHelp: The planning agent turns the objective into tasks with dependencies and acceptance criteria.
tasks.objectiveTextHelp: Describe the outcome you want. A planning agent (one with the "plan tasks" permission) must be on the project.
tasks.empty: No tasks yet. Submit an objective to plan some.
tasks.emptyNoProject: Create a project first, then submit an objective.

review.title: Review
review.help: A task is only completed when a reviewer accepts its evidence.
review.noteRequired: Write a note explaining what must change.

errors.name_taken: A project with this name already exists.
errors.task_not_in_review: This task is no longer awaiting review.
errors.note_required: Write a note explaining what must change.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.

tasks.criticalOperation: Critical operation: {op} — completion needs a human approval.

evaluation.title: Evaluation

checks.no_tool_denials: No tool calls denied by policy

evaluation.help: Deterministic checks decide; a reviewer model can only withhold approval. Tests, lint and security scans are not measured until the sandbox is available.

approvals.title: Approval center
approvals.subtitle: Critical operations requested by agents wait here. Nothing in this list runs until a human decides.
approvals.emptyPending: Nothing is waiting for a decision.
approvals.payloadHelp: This is exactly what was requested. It was fingerprinted at request time; any later change is refused.
approvals.payloadHelpExecutable: On approval the platform runs exactly this operation, once. It was fingerprinted at request time; any later change is refused.

decision.title: Your decision
decision.reasonHelp: Required to reject or request changes; recorded with your decision.
decision.reasonRequired: Write the reason for this decision.
decision.ack: I have reviewed the operation and its evidence.

errors.self_approval_forbidden: You cannot decide on a request you made yourself.
errors.approval_not_pending: This request has already been decided.
errors.reason_required: Write the reason for this decision.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission for this.

operations.task_critical: Accept a task that performs a critical operation

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every security-relevant action by people, agents and the platform. Secrets are redacted.

evaluations.title: Evaluations
evaluations.subtitle: Independent, evidence-based verdicts on agent work, and the performance profiles that steer task assignment.
evaluations.trustedHelp: Profiles with at least {n} evaluations are trusted and used when assigning tasks.

github.title: GitHub
github.subtitle: Connected repositories, agent branches and pull requests. Agents never write to protected branches; merges need an approval.
github.connectHelp: The token is checked against GitHub, then stored encrypted. Only its last 4 characters are ever shown.
github.worktreesHelp: Every task gets its own branch and working copy; overlapping files and conflicts with the base branch are tracked.

fields.tokenHelp: A fine-grained token with Contents and Pull requests read/write on this repository.
fields.webhookHelp: At least 16 characters; use the same secret in the repository's webhook settings.

errors.badToken: GitHub rejected the token for this repository.
errors.notFound: Repository not found or not visible to this token.
errors.unreachable: GitHub could not be reached. Try again later.

supervisor.title: Agent supervisor
supervisor.subtitle: Independent monitoring of agent and execution health. It may take reversible actions; it never overrides approvals or security policy.

memory.title: Context & Memory
memory.subtitle: What agents remember about each project, where it came from, and whether a human verified it. Correct or delete anything that is wrong — agents only ever see current, unexpired memories of their own project.
memory.empty: No memories for this project yet.
memory.corrected: Correction saved as a new version.
memory.deleteBody: “{title}” and all of its earlier versions will be deleted permanently. Agents will no longer receive it.
memory.correctHelp: Your correction becomes a new, verified version; the previous version is kept as history and no longer used.
memory.addHelp: Memories you add are marked as verified and scoped to the selected project.
memory.contextHelp: The exact context the platform would assemble for a task right now: trusted requirements first, then untrusted data (prerequisite outputs and memories) fenced so it can never override platform policy.

searchMode.title: Search mode
searchMode.help: Memories are found by matching words plus a local similarity index. You can add an embedding model so that memories with the same meaning but different words are found too.
searchMode.pending: {n, plural, =0 {All memories are indexed.} one {# memory waiting to be indexed.} other {# memories waiting to be indexed.}}
searchMode.providerHelp: OpenAI or an OpenAI-compatible server (e.g. Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM).
searchMode.egress: The text of every memory will be sent to {name} to be indexed.
searchMode.egressLocal: The text of every memory will be sent to the server of {name} to be indexed; for a server on your own machine it stays local.
searchMode.saved: Search mode saved; memories are being indexed.

integrations.title: MCP & A2A
integrations.subtitle: Register MCP servers, issue access keys for the platform's own MCP server and A2A keys for agent-to-agent calls. Everything external is inspected first and stays disabled until a person enables it.
integrations.enableHelp: Review the security assessment before enabling.
integrations.acceptRisks: I reviewed the high-risk findings and accept them. This acceptance is recorded in the audit log.
integrations.serversHelp: Agents can only use tools of servers that are enabled, tools that are enabled, and only when the agent was assigned the server and the tool's permission.
integrations.registerHelp: The server is assessed and stays disabled. Tokens are stored encrypted and never shown again.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.commandHelp: One argument per line, e.g. the program then its arguments.
integrations.deleteServerBody: “{name}” will be removed and unassigned from all agents.
integrations.availableHelp: Skill folders on the platform host. Installing inspects every file; nothing is executed.
integrations.inspectHelp: Static inspection of instructions, scripts and dependencies.
integrations.assignHelp: Assigned agents receive the skill's instructions in their task context while the skill is enabled.
integrations.deleteSkillBody: “{name}” will be removed from all agents.
integrations.keysHelp: Keys let external MCP clients call selected platform tools at
integrations.tokenOnce: Copy this key now — it will not be shown again.
integrations.skillsSubtitle: Install skills from host folders after a security inspection, enable them deliberately and assign them to agents.
integrations.a2aHelp: External agents call the selected agents over A2A JSON-RPC at

bridge.title: Browser Bridge
bridge.subtitle: Lets authorized agents use AI chat websites inside dedicated, isolated browser profiles. Official APIs and CLIs remain the recommended way.
bridge.warningBody: Many providers' terms prohibit automating their consumer websites. Each provider stays locked until a Super Admin acknowledges its terms. The bridge never reads cookies or passwords, never solves CAPTCHAs, and stops when a page changes.
bridge.ackHelp: Read the provider's terms first. The exact statement below is recorded in the audit log.
bridge.ackCheckbox: I have read the terms and accept this statement.
bridge.profileHelp: A dedicated browser profile created by the platform (lowercase letters, digits, dashes). Never your personal browser profile.
bridge.disabledHelp: Enable the bridge to start sessions.

errors.terms_not_acknowledged: This provider's terms have not been acknowledged.
errors.bridge_unreachable: The bridge service is not running.
errors.login_required: Sign-in required: a person must sign in in the bridge window.
errors.captcha_detected: A CAPTCHA appeared. A person must solve it — the bridge never does.
errors.interface_changed: The page changed and no longer matches the adapter. The session stopped safely.
errors.profile_in_use: This profile is already in use by a live session.
errors.too_many_sessions: The maximum number of live sessions is reached.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: Every project has a mode — new, existing (built on a repository that already exists) or maintenance — a roster of agents, an optional team and budget.
projects.modeHelp: Existing and maintenance projects are planned from a static map of their repository.
projects.name: Name
projects.budgetHelp: When spending reaches it, new work in this project pauses and an approval is requested.
projects.repoMapHelp: A read-only inspection of the repository: nothing is executed.

errors.no_repository: This project has no repository yet. Link and import one, or let agents create it.
errors.no_linked_repository: Link a GitHub repository to this project first.
errors.budgets_manage_required: Changing budgets needs the budgets permission.
errors.name_taken: A project with this name already exists.

teams.title: Agent Teams
teams.subtitle: Group agents and people. Teams can own projects and share team memories.
teams.deleteBody: “{name}” will be deleted. Its projects stay and simply have no team.
teams.help: Only agents and people of your organization can be members.
teams.name: Name

errors.lead_must_be_a_member: The lead agent must be a member of the team.
errors.name_taken: A team with this name already exists.

executions.title: Executions
executions.subtitle: Every agent execution with its full timeline: state changes, tool calls and results, logs, usage and errors.
executions.pick: Select an execution to see its timeline.

question.title: The agent is waiting for your answer
question.help: The agent continues with your answer as soon as you send it. It is treated as information, not as instructions that override its rules.
question.noPermission: Someone allowed to control executions has to answer.

orchestration.title: Orchestration
orchestration.subtitle: Objectives the manager is planning and executing, and the automations that start work on a schedule or after an event.
orchestration.workflowsHelp: Submit new objectives from the task board.
orchestration.automationsHelp: Automations run inside the platform's worker only — nothing is installed on your computer. Every run is recorded.
orchestration.deleteBody: “{name}” and its history will be deleted.
orchestration.dialogHelp: Runs use the permissions of the person who last saved the automation.
orchestration.name: Name
orchestration.cronHelp: Five fields in UTC, e.g. 0 3 * * 1-5 (weekdays at 03:00). At most every 5 minutes.
orchestration.eventHelp: An audit action, e.g. github.pr_merged or approvals.approved.

runtime.title: Agent Runtime
runtime.subtitle: The execution engines available to agents, the state of all executions and every open circuit breaker.

engineHelp.api: Official provider APIs through the gateway.
engineHelp.mock: Clearly labelled mock output for tests and demos.
engineHelp.a2a: Remote agents over the A2A protocol.
engineHelp.cli: Local coding CLIs in the sandbox.

runtime.circuitsHelp: After repeated failures an agent or provider is paused for a cool-down; one trial is then let through.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.subtitle: Usage and cost by provider, model, agent, project or day — only recorded numbers, never estimates.
analytics.honesty: Costs are calculated only for models with configured prices; mock usage is excluded.
analytics.budgetsHelp: When a budget is reached, new work in its scope stops, completed results are kept and an approval for more spending is requested. Everything else continues.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Your preferences and, for administrators, users and roles.
settings.passwordHelp: At least 12 characters. You can only grant roles whose permissions you hold yourself.

errors.cannot_grant_higher_privileges: You cannot grant a role with more permissions than your own.
